steps.title: Recruit and Screen Participants
steps.instruction: Identify potential participants at the Khula Ndoda Male Circumcision Clinic using systematic random sampling.

substeps.instruction: Target every 5th person who has completed the circumcision pre-assessment and HIV post-test counselling.
Verify inclusion criteria: HIV-negative males aged 18-40 years, likely to reside in/around Soweto for the next 12 months.
Verify exclusion criteria: Individuals unable to provide follow-up contact details or those who exclusively have sex with men.
If the 5th person is ineligible, consider the next person until an appropriate participant accepts, then restart the 5th-person cycle.

steps.title: Obtain Informed Consent
steps.instruction: Enroll eligible participants after providing full information regarding the study's purpose, requirements, and demands.

substeps.instruction: Ensure participants understand they may withdraw at any time without affecting their treatment.
Provide contact details for research regulatory bodies.
Obtain a signed consent form.
Provide a reimbursement of R30 for travel and inconvenience.

steps.title: Baseline Data Collection
steps.instruction: Collect primary demographic, biological, and behavioral data on the day of circumcision prior to the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Administer an interviewer-led questionnaire covering demographic (age, marital status, education), behavioral (condom use, number of partners, drug/alcohol use), and psychological risk factors.
Record biological measurements: weight, height, BMI, blood pressure, haemoglobin, and glucose levels.
Perform a rapid HIV test to confirm negative status (if indeterminate, repeat using whole blood sample for HIV ELISA).

steps.title: Perform Circumcision and Initial Follow-up
steps.instruction: Refer the participant for the circumcision procedure as per the standard of care and monitor for immediate complications.

substeps.instruction: Conduct the circumcision procedure.
Perform a follow-up visit 2 to 7 days post-circumcision to check for surgical complications and collect adverse event data.

steps.title: Conduct Long-term Follow-up
steps.instruction: Monitor participants at scheduled intervals to determine HIV incidence and risk factors.

substeps.instruction: Schedule follow-up visits at 6 months and 12 months post-circumcision.
Administer the follow-up questionnaire to collect updated behavioral and demographic data.
Perform a rapid HIV test at each visit.
Maintain participant retention via telephone calls or SMS reminders at least once a month.

steps.title: Manage Seroconversion
steps.instruction: Provide immediate care for participants who test HIV positive during the study.

substeps.instruction: Perform a CD4 count for any participant who seroconverts.
Refer the participant for appropriate treatment according to the standard of care.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Process collected data using Epi-data (with double entry for quality check) and STATA software.

substeps.instruction: Perform univariate analysis on characteristics of HIV-negative males, recoding age into 18-24 and 25-40 groups.
Use chi-squared tests (or Fisher's test for cells < 5) for categorical variables and t-tests for continuous variables to determine significant differences in HIV status.
Conduct bivariate logistic regression at 15% significance, followed by multivariate logistic regression modelling.
Compare demographic and risk characteristics of participants lost to follow-up against those who remained.
